faviconDirection.concept: Simplified fruit-versus-zombie survival icon derived from the official Roblox game icon crop, reduced to one bold fruit shape and one survival bite cue.
faviconDirection.silhouette: Large round fruit silhouette with a small contrasting bite/slash mark, centered in a square icon.
faviconDirection.generationPromptEnglish: Create a 512x512 PNG favicon for a Roblox Fruit Zombie Survival guide site: one bold green fruit silhouette with a simple purple survival bite accent, dark background, high contrast, clean vector-like edges, strong outline.
faviconDirection.foreground: Green fruit silhouette with purple accent based on official visual evidence.
faviconDirection.background: Dark survival backdrop matching the site dark token.
smallSizeRules: At 16x16 keep only the round fruit silhouette and single bite accent.
Use flat shapes and remove decorative marks before ICO export.
